inventory_movements_direction.name: inventory_movements_direction
inventory_movements_direction.value:
("inventory_movements"."type" in ('IN', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'COUNT_SURPLUS') and "inventory_movements"."quantity_change" > 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" in ('OUT', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'COUNT_SHORTAGE', 'WASTE') and "inventory_movements"."quantity_change" < 0)
        or ("inventory_movements"."type" = 'REVERSAL' and "inventory_movements"."quantity_change" <> 0)

invitations_used_by_requires_used_at.name: invitations_used_by_requires_used_at
invitations_used_by_requires_used_at.value: "invitations"."used_by" is null or "invitations"."used_at" is not null
